statement: Warren 2026-10-19: product identity uses every identifier the file provides, resolved in the platform order: Part number -> Barcode -> Sales model; Customer product code resolves through the customer's own code aliases. Barcode matches Product Master EAN OR UPC. Exact / normalised-exact only, never fuzzy; one match wins only if unambiguous; disagreements between identifiers on one row are flagged, not guessed. At least one identifier must be mapped.
